text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is Furioso.
Allow me to make my declaration once again.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to the Central.
I'll show them the strength of Funabashi through my running.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us walk this path together.
For the future of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
